description: Scan text against a curated table of wordy/redundant phrases ("due to the fact that", "in order to", "at this point in time") and flag each occurrence with a suggested concise replacement, an occurrence count, and character offsets. Dictionary-based heuristic: a flagged phrase is a candidate to tighten, not always wrong in context.

text.description: The text to scan for wordy/redundant phrases

name: detect_wordy_phrases
